page.overview:
Who is Lian Cerox?

Lian Cerox was a human Cerox and fellow ambassador Tintak were the two chosen representatives for Eiram and E'ronoh at the summit on Jedha. While she had not forgiven the people of E'ronoh for the war and resented the royal family for thinking they could simply call off the hatred she held for their enemies, she was more than willing to carry out the peace process until it exploded into active combat.
